title: Athlete brands
disclaimer: For information only. Not investment advice, and not a solicitation or offer. Roles and figures are as stated by the linked source, as of the source date where one is shown. A blank cell means the source did not state it. Values and stakes are as reported or estimated by the linked source. They are not Backfield estimates and may not reflect current value. A round figure is the total size of the funding round the athlete joined or led, not the athlete's stake.
